skill.summary: Perform security operations on OpenClaw environments by calling Alibaba Cloud Security Center (SAS) and ECS APIs via the aliyun CLI. Supports asset queries,...

latestVersion.changelog:
**Summary: Enforces aliyun CLI version, plugin update, and standardized user-agent for all operations.**

- Requires aliyun CLI version 3.3.3 or above, with pre-check and upgrade instructions.
- Mandates aliyun CLI plugin auto-update and manual `aliyun plugin update` before execution.
- All CLI calls must now append `--user-agent AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-sas-openclaw-security`.
- Enhanced documentation in SKILL.md to reflect new strict environment and user-agent requirements.
- Minor updates to scripts and references to support and clarify these enforcement policies.
